title: Canonical hover occurrence binding (compiler Task 1)
description: One edge from a source-addressed Qur'anic occurrence to a canonical payload identity. binding_status=accepted requires a canonical Quran + WBW loc and an exact entry/card trace. binding_gate=certified_lemma requires lemma_status=certified; binding_gate=function_context requires nahw/function certification; surface-only fanout is never accepted; homograph groups require a loc+lemma/context gate, never strict-surface alone. A non-accepted binding MUST carry a `reason` (the terminal-packet taxonomy). exact_transclusion_group_key + canonical_payload_id are the two node types of the source-address graph (typed-edge compatible). Dry-run; source-clean. See CANONICAL_HOVER_PAYLOAD_COMPILER_PLAN (fablehardening) + its two addenda.
